maria-cs: Customer reports chat stream cuts off mid-response on mobile app, partial final tokens only. Request ID: req_0a2b3c4d. Route: POST /v1/chat/stream. Model: redwood-medium-1. They say it usually stops ~1.8s after first chunk. Happening across multiple regions. Attached the customer's minimal curl they tried:

maria-cs: ```curl -N -H 'Accept: text/event-stream' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/stream?model=redwood-medium-1' -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hello"}]}'```

 tom-eng: thanks — can you paste the full edge request log for req_0a2b3c4d and the exact SDK/version the customer uses? Also are they going through a proxy (nginx, cloud provider LB, app proxy)?

maria-cs: customer says mobile -> corporate proxy -> internet. SDK is our js-client v0.9.1 in their backend which proxies mobile requests. Full edge snippet from our side: 

maria-cs: ```[edge] 2026-03-17T14:22:11Z req=req_0a2b3c4d start stream
[edge] 2026-03-17T14:22:12Z req=req_0a2b3c4d chunk sent len=128
[edge] 2026-03-17T14:22:13Z req=req_0a2b3c4d chunk sent len=64
[edge] 2026-03-17T14:22:13Z req=req_0a2b3c4d client_close by upstream?
[edge] 2026-03-17T14:22:13Z req=req_0a2b3c4d stream ended status=499
```

li-eng: 499 from our edge usually means client closed connection. But that can be caused by an intermediary timing out or buffering then closing. Two immediate repro tasks: reproduce raw SSE from their network path (curl -N -v) and reproduce websocket path if they use ws. Ask customer to run these exact commands from the same host that proxies for mobile.

li-eng: SSE repro curl (verbose, no buffering):
```bash
curl -N -v -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}' \n  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/stream?model=redwood-medium-1"
```

li-eng: If they are behind nginx, ask them to try `proxy_buffering off;` on the location that proxies the stream. Also tell them to ensure `proxy_http_version 1.1;` and `chunked_transfer_encoding on;`. Example snippet: 
```nginx
location /proxy_stream/ {
  proxy_pass https://api.redwood.ai;
  proxy_http_version 1.1;
  proxy_set_header Connection "";
  proxy_buffering off;
  proxy_cache off;
}
```

kevin-qa: small tip: curl's stdout can be buffered by the terminal or the proxy chain; use `-N` to disable curl buffering and pipe to `stdbuf -oL cat` or `pv -qL 10` to see data as it arrives. For websockets you can repro with `wscat -c "wss://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/ws?model=redwood-medium-1" -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY"`.

maria-cs: customer uploaded a debug bundle and tcpdump from their proxy host: https://redwood-internal.s3/debug-bundles/req_0a2b3c4d.tgz (private link). Bundle includes nginx conf, access logs, and tcpdump.

 tom-eng: grabbing the bundle now. If tcpdump shows complete SSE chunks leaving our edge but only coalesced data reaching the client, intermediary is buffering. If tcpdump shows truncated outgoing from our edge, that's on us. I'll check edge connection logs for that req and correlate with the bundle.

li-eng: also check TLS termination point — some older proxies drop keep-alive after a small idle. For SSE we send periodic colon keepalive comments to keep connections open; if the proxy disassembles that, it can look like inactivity and cause closes. Recommend customer add `proxy_read_timeout` and `send_timeout` higher for streaming locations.

maria-cs: forwarding nginx snippet + ask them to run both curl commands and paste full `-v` output and the raw tcpdump capture before we dig deeper. I'll update them with suggested nginx settings. :thumbsup:

kevin-qa: if customer can't change proxy, as a workaround they can switch to websocket path (if supported) since some proxies treat WS frames differently. But we should root-cause. I'll watch this thread for edge traces.

 tom-eng: noted — I'll post back once I correlate edge logs and the debug bundle. If we need a repro VM I can spin up a small proxy with the same nginx config and test.

maria-cs: thanks team — customer will try the curl -N and nginx changes, will upload results to the bundle link.
